**Edge cases tested:** hook fires → convert executes and the artifact reaches the stage; hook returns false → keep, stage not called; nil hook → safely kept; adapter Acquire returns the legacy session and Release returns it (session count round-trips 0→1→0); adapter Execute returns the sentinel `ErrNotImplemented` (wrapped by the stage, never silently swallowed); oracle period respects the pre-existing `Config.OraclePeriod` (not a hard-coded value); end-to-end activation — a real ticker tick propagates oracle → hook → CoderLLM, proving the pipeline no longer stops at the oracle.
